claims.statement: For pairwise physically disjoint real pieces b_j, the uniform sign ensemble satisfies average_epsilon Eraw(sum epsilon_j b_j)<=sum_j Eraw(b_j) and average_epsilon I(sum epsilon_j b_j)=sum_j I(b_j).
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, piece counts, norms, densities and Fourier overlaps; no piece-count or gluing-depth factor.

claims.statement: For Boolean f and any Hamming-cube isometry tau, a=(f+f o tau)/2 and b=(f-f o tau)/2 satisfy H(f)<=Eraw(a)+Eraw(b) and I(f)=I(a)+I(b). If both masks have FEI constant C, then so does f.
claims.scope: Universal two-piece ternary reduction; combined with the affine-cylinder theorem gives Boolean FEI constant max(C,4) for that class.

claims.statement: The inequality Eraw(b0+b1)<=Eraw(b0)+Eraw(b1) fails for disjoint ternary pieces in dimension three by 0.515679411089406... bits.
claims.scope: Exact truth-table witness; positivity certified by 7^98>2^128*3^72.

claims.statement: The complete sign ensemble has a dimension- and depth-free payment. General FEI still requires a witness controlling the correlation gap of the one prescribed physical signing.
